infer: Cannot infer the task workspace on {machine}; choose a workspace explicitly
unavailable: Workspace {path} is not an available absolute directory
not_found: Workspace {workspace} was not found on {machine}; select a workspace there or enter an absolute path
prepare: Cannot prepare a new task workspace on {machine}; no agent was started
engine_path: The workspace engine returned no absolute checkout path; no agent was started
busy: Workspace is occupied by task {id} ({title}); wait for it to finish or choose a new workspace (machine {machine}, path {path})
machine_local: The task workspace was created on {from}; it cannot move to {to}
create: The new task workspace was not made; no agent was started
